meta.title: Context usage and budget
meta.description: Shows context occupancy and its composition (system prompt / tools & subagents / messages / connectors & MCP / skills) right of the composer, and tiers a context window above 256K by min(128K, (window − 256K) × 0.5) per step, with the full window as the last tier. Exceeding the chosen budget summarizes the oldest history before the next step.
